summary: Full backend API test suite for EZtoFind.ca Phase 1 MVP. All 19 pytest tests passed (100% success): health check, glossary list (25+ terms) & AI-generated FAQs (Claude Sonnet 4.6), communities (BC regions), buyer/seller leads with CASL/PIPA consent validation, 3-stage REALTOR referral flow, admin JWT login, admin-protected endpoints, CRM clients + reminders window (30 days), and Doogie SSE streaming chat.

minor.issue: Uses query-string parameter for `status` instead of JSON body - inconsistent with rest of the API (POST body pattern). Not blocking but violates REST consistency.
When same email applies twice the endpoint returns 200 with the pre-existing id. Fine for MVP but does not surface a distinct 'already applied' status code.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI - should migrate to lifespan context manager (non-blocking).

critical_code_review_comments: generate_faqs_for_term returns [] silently on failure - consider raising or logging structured error so glossary detail page can retry. Currently a failed generation causes empty faqs to be persisted only if the array is non-empty (good), but partial/invalid JSON is swallowed.
Reminders logic uses d.replace(year=today.year) which will raise for Feb 29 birthdays - the current try/except silently drops that client's reminder. Consider a leap-day safe replacement.

CORS allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is not spec-compliant and modern browsers block credentialed requests with wildcard origins. Not blocking for this MVP (no cookies used) but worth tightening.
server.py is a single 387-line file - approaching the split threshold; consider modularising routes (leads, realtors, glossary, admin, doogie) as the app grows.
No rate limiting on public POST endpoints (/api/leads/buyer, /api/leads/seller, /api/realtors/apply, /api/doogie/chat) - abuse risk on a public-facing marketing site.
test_credentials: Admin: doug@eztofind.ca / EZtoFind2026! (from /app/backend/.env). No /app/memory/test_credentials.md file present.
seed_data_creation: Tests inserted TEST_-prefixed buyer/seller leads, realtor applications and one CRM client with birthdate/anniversary/possession_date to validate the reminders endpoint. No cleanup performed - safe since data is prefixed and only used for verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 19 backend tests pass against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (proptech-hub-111 preview host). The suite covers root health, glossary (list + AI FAQ generation for property-transfer-tax-ptt), communities BC regions, buyer/seller leads (consent success + missing-CASL rejection), 3-stage realtor flow (apply -> credentials -> profile, plus agreement_25pct rejection), admin login (success + wrong pw + unauth 401), admin leads listing, reminders window with a freshly created client, and Doogie SSE streaming (validates text/event-stream content-type, delta events and terminal done event). Frontend testing was intentionally skipped per review_request.
